headlines.title: Saudis Tell OPEC That Output Slumped Again to Lowest Since 1990
headlines.summary: Saudi output at a 36-year low is the supply-side gut punch that keeps Brent above $100 and forces every central bank on the planet to reprice their inflation path. This hits energy stocks, airlines, trucking, consumer staples margins, and the long bond all at once — that's not a sector story, that's a tape story. The EIA already hiked its price forecasts; now the OPEC data confirms the supply hole is real, not just war-premium noise.

headlines.title: An ECB rate hike is 'all but certain' — but investors divided on what comes next
headlines.summary: A central bank hiking into an oil shock while its own economy is getting squeezed — that's the kind of policy mistake that moves European equities, the euro, and sovereign spreads hard. The uncertainty about the terminal rate is what keeps traders honest; if Lagarde sounds hawkish beyond today, you'll feel it in U.S. Treasuries too as global rate expectations reprice. Watch the long bond — this ECB decision feeds directly into the U.S. yield story that's already rattling stocks.

headlines.title: Treasuries Fall Ahead of Auction as Trump Pledges Payout
headlines.summary: A $1 trillion-plus cash giveaway promise dropped right before a 30-year bond auction is the kind of fiscal recklessness that makes bond vigilantes reach for the sell button — and when the long bond sells off, everything with a multiple gets repriced. Bessent is already losing credibility with the market after his convention speech, and now the boss is promising checks to voters; that's a dangerous combo heading into a rate-sensitive tape. This one's got legs beyond today's auction.
